---
title: ""
page-layout: article
title-block-banner: false
---

<div id="gate" style="max-width:360px; margin:80px auto; text-align:center;">
  <h2 style="font-size:1.4rem; margin-bottom:0.4rem;">Pearls of Wisdom</h2>
  <p style="color:#6e6e73; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">Password required.</p>
  <input
    id="pwd"
    type="password"
    placeholder="Enter password"
    onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') unlock()"
    style="width:100%; padding:0.5rem 0.75rem; border:1px solid #ebebeb; border-radius:6px; font-size:1rem; outline:none; box-sizing:border-box;"
  />
  <button
    onclick="unlock()"
    style="margin-top:0.75rem; width:100%; padding:0.5rem; background:#2d6a4f; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:6px; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer;"
  >Enter</button>
  <p id="err" style="display:none; color:#c0392b; font-size:0.85rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">Wrong password.</p>
</div>

<div id="pearls" style="display:none; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto;">
  <h1 style="font-size:1.6rem; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">Pearls of Wisdom</h1>
  <p style="color:#6e6e73; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:2rem;">Daily rantings. Handle with care.</p>

  <div class="pearl-list">

    <!-- ADD NEW PEARLS AT THE TOP. Format:
    <div class="pearl">
      <span class="pearl-date">YYYY-MM-DD</span>
      <p class="pearl-text">Your 1-2 sentence ranting here.</p>
    </div>
    -->

    <div class="pearl">
      <span class="pearl-date">2026-08-01</span>
      <p class="pearl-text">Every expert was once a beginner who refused to quit. The only difference is they kept going when it stopped being fun.</p>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<style>
.pearl-list {
  border-top: 1px solid #ebebeb;
}
.pearl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1.1rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ebebeb;
  align-items: start;
}
.pearl-date {
  color: #6e6e73;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding-top: 0.15rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.pearl-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.97rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #1a1a1a;
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .pearl {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
const HASH = "074f2d98a216b0b52af5665889d5aefd4e5025cdb0a73b0b855c6cff86e61d30";

async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

async function unlock() {
  const val = document.getElementById("pwd").value;
  const hash = await sha256(val);
  if (hash === HASH) {
    sessionStorage.setItem("pearls_ok", "1");
    show();
  } else {
    document.getElementById("err").style.display = "block";
  }
}

function show() {
  document.getElementById("gate").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("pearls").style.display = "block";
}

window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  if (sessionStorage.getItem("pearls_ok") === "1") show();
});
</script>
